name: @folienbaukasten/create-extension
description: Scaffold a Folienbaukasten extension — npm create @folienbaukasten/extension
$comment: Its own package rather than a subcommand of the toolkit, because `npm create <name>` resolves to the package `create-<name>` — scopes included — so this has to be @folienbaukasten/create-extension to be reachable by the one command anybody will actually try. It also stays small: the toolkit carries a 300 KB ABI bundle, and a scaffolder downloaded once and thrown away should not.
